Travel Notice for Companion Animal Passengers

Travelers should review animal travel notes before they arrive, so the desk can help match each pet with the right care and paperwork.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways keeps records in the ledger, follows calm handling practices, and checks details from booking through pickup. If you are bringing a pet, please make sure the crate is secure, the animal is settled, and the documents are ready for review. <<FACT F066>> Staff will use that information to guide safe loading and to avoid delays at the counter. The team values humane care and will pass along any service change through the desk notes.

For larger animals, the desk will confirm the applicable charge before travel is accepted. <<FACT F057>> If anything in your booking changes, share it early so the review can stay orderly and the next step can be chosen without confusion. Travelers who need help with arrival handoff or carrier checks can speak with the desk directly.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for personal help and the latest travel guidance.
